scope: Complete public-definition census of five arithmetic completion/bridge files and the native policy-macro file, and a typed assessment of every row of the existing policy contract. This is not a theorem interpreting every policy in native Resolve.

arithmetic_grammar.descent: Operations are first constructed on representatives and proved compatible with the quotient. FaithfulComponentRing transfers laws only after source operations and preservation proofs exist.
arithmetic_grammar.native_execution: SignedBridge and FractionBridge instantiate NativeCoefficientTransport; every finite marked sum/product Expr has direct and translated native executions with commuting readouts.
arithmetic_grammar.inputs: Inductive Word, set-quotient/type-theoretic infrastructure and library algebra used in proofs. Factor weights and the geometric component-normal-form hypothesis remain supplied.
arithmetic_grammar.inverse_boundary: The recorded source proves inversion of each admitted positive component denominator. Do not promote this to an independently formalized universal localization theorem for arbitrary targets.

groups.rule: Word pairs and the balance set quotient.
Construct representative arithmetic from component append and multiply; negation swaps the pair.
Difference of numeral images, descending through Balance into a supplied commutative ring.
Ring polynomial identities and compatibility with representative arithmetic and Balance.
Compare to the library difference quotient and signed normal forms; prove roundtrips and faithful readout.
Show constructed representative operations commute with integer readout.
Descend operations, prove their readouts and additive inverse, and assemble the source commutative ring.
Embed Word as (n,0), preserving constructed addition and multiplication.
Strictly positive word denominators, constructed product, and compatibility with signed/library readouts.
Signed numerator/positive denominator pairs modulo component cross multiplication.
Construct coefficient-quotient/readout roundtrips and cross-relation compatibility; not package equivalence from scalar equality.
Construct representative operations first and prove their rational readouts.
Descend the constructed operations, then transfer ring laws through the faithful readout.
Embed signed coefficients at denominator one and invert every admitted positive component denominator.
Transfer laws through an injective readout only after source operations and preservation proofs are supplied.
Retain all factor labels while recursively transporting expressions along a coefficient homomorphism, with evaluation and both native readout squares.
Reuse the existing channel weights and marked 1/600 factor; construct actual native execution, obtaining the existing 6/25 scalar with both readout comparisons.
Check signed cancellation and equality of common-factor fraction representatives in the coefficient quotient.
Construct actual P-kind applications and recover their original premise packages and derivations. No output is admitted as a fresh literal.

policy_assessments.available: The path ledger's source/target family and deconstruct_family give exact ordered-record recovery; TableFibrationCycle supplies the record-presentation recovery theorem.
policy_assessments.missing: A typed macro connecting the particular record presentation and its admission certificates to native Package/Resolve. The existence of an equivalence does not itself admit its endpoint packages.
policy_assessments.test: Reject a view dropping a record or changing stage order; require forward/backward package and derivation maps before claiming a native macro.

policy_assessments.available: Native rules retain supplied pointed equivalences, inverses/composites and path lifting.
policy_assessments.missing: The actual representation acting jointly on maps, witnesses and any metric; relabelling covariance alone does not construct it.
policy_assessments.test: With a supplied representation, verify that the transported selected package and every protected witness commute; do not compare only endpoint dimensions.

policy_assessments.available: The DG source supplies C2*r*C1 and reference/higher-witness corrections. Native compose-kind instead composes pointed equivalences and retains both parents.
policy_assessments.missing: A typed interpretation of DG maps, weak return and corrections; arbitrary actual/reference maps need not be equivalences.
policy_assessments.test: A noninjective exact map cannot be the equivalence parameter. Either preserve an explicitly larger record or provide a different computational interpretation.

policy_assessments.available: The source operation retains actual maps and versions reference/witness data with a supplied change witness.
policy_assessments.missing: A type-correct map from that DG reference-change witness to native pointed package equivalence or higher-path data; these witness types are not silently interchangeable.
policy_assessments.test: Two substitutions must agree with direct substitution at the retained-reference package, including mixed witness components.

policy_assessments.available: The candidate protocol checks [g,delta(v)]=0 and [g,v]=delta(K_g), then updates W to g*W+K_g*d.
policy_assessments.missing: A representation and filler-space policy plus an actual certificate; native generic Admit does not generate K_g or select the request.
policy_assessments.test: Reject requests without certificates even if their label permutation exists; check certificate composition/inversion for admitted requests.

policy_assessments.available: History is retained; native higher-kind records an actual equality between supplied paths.
policy_assessments.missing: A permission/readout/cost policy and a bridge between its allowed edits and the native path type. Equal readouts do not imply path equality.
policy_assessments.test: Keep two equal-readout histories distinct unless the declared edit policy and actual witness justify the change.

policy_assessments.available: GeneratingGrammarMacros.Retained.family-run constructs the actual P-kind derivation; family-premise recovers each original package AND its derivation by refl.
policy_assessments.missing: The grouping, fresh-label identity policy and next-level endpoints; the retention macro does not supply them or independent copies.
policy_assessments.test: Changing or dropping a member must change the retained package; require explicit next endpoints rather than inferring them from a label count.

policy_assessments.available: Membership in the intersection of member permission sets means every member supplies permission for the same request. P-kind can retain the resulting family of certificate packages.
policy_assessments.missing: A mapping from these member permissions to the declared Admit family; native P-kind itself neither chooses nor proves an admission policy.
policy_assessments.test: Compare direct versus staged intersection and reject a request refused by even one retained member.

policy_assessments.available: GeneratingGrammarMacros.Retained.pair-run constructs the actual ordered-pair derivation; pair-left-premise and pair-right-premise recover both original packages and derivations by refl.
policy_assessments.missing: This pairs supplied operands. It does not construct an independent new operand or establish independence by duplicating an existing derivation.
policy_assessments.test: Retain the two operand dependency identities; reject using fresh labels or repeated leaves as a proof of independence.

coverage_boundary.closed: Public declarations/module schemas/aliases in the six named arithmetic/macro files; every row in the policy ledger has an explicit assessment.
coverage_boundary.open: A generation-preserving interpreter for every policy and retained-path computation, and an authoritative boundary for all sector operations in the repository.
coverage_boundary.prohibited_shortcut: Neither admitting the desired answer as a fresh seed, storing an arbitrary external computation as an atom, nor labelling an unproved correspondence an equivalence counts as deriving the operation.
coverage_boundary.next_executable: Construct a typed native interpreter for the DG comparison operation with its weak-return correction, under a frozen admission policy. Pairing and family-retention macros are now implemented and checked; they do not close that computational adapter.
